propositions: Step-budget exhaustion diagnostic is computed in interpret_failure but discarded before reaching raise_completion_workflow_failure because failure_diagnostic is only set in _recover, which budget exhaustion never reaches

The gate_error_v1 sidecar is not emitted for budget exhaustion failures because emit_gate_error is gated on truthy failure_diagnostic, leaving operators unable to distinguish looping from budget constraint without reading logs

_bounded_diagnostic allowlist and merge() scalar-only guard strip repetition counter keys (tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, distinct_ratio_window) even when present on the caught exception
The operator-facing close-gate message must render distinct-vs-total tool-call counts from the aggregate_-prefixed diagnostic keys to disambiguate looping from resource exhaustion
The sidecar payload must survive the primary-exception merge with aggregate_ prefixes while remaining free of prompts, arguments, and response text
